bullets.text: Awesome Copilot MCP Server Launched - **Microsoft** introduces a new server to enhance GitHub Copilot customizations and streamline development.
Top AI Observability Practices - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of agent observability for reliable AI performance and safety.
Storm-0501 Adapts to Cloud Ransomware - **Microsoft** warns of evolving tactics from threat actor Storm-0501 targeting cloud environments.
Microsoft Defender Dominates Market - **Microsoft** retains the top spot in modern endpoint security market share for the third consecutive year.
Gears of War: Reloaded Available - **Microsoft** revives a classic game, now accessible via multiple platforms including PC Game Pass.
AI Accelerates Scientific Discovery - **Microsoft Azure** and **NVIDIA** collaborate to enhance research capabilities using AI and cloud technology.
Securing Autonomous Agents - **Microsoft** outlines strategies for the governance and security of increasingly autonomous AI agents.
Azure Infrastructure Security Enhanced - **Microsoft** details its comprehensive approach to securing Azure from silicon to systems.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - **Microsoft** releases new Insider Preview builds with features enhancing cross-device app usage.
My Apps Feature for PC Gamers - **Microsoft** introduces a new feature in the Xbox PC App for quicker game access.
